title: Invariance of logarithmic pluricanonical lattices of semistable models
statement: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field $K$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring, def-pc-field-extension] and put $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $f_i:X_i\to S$, for $i=1,2$, be projective flat finitely presented morphisms with nonempty connected reduced one-dimensional geometric fibres, all of whose singularities are ordinary double points, and let $a_{i1},\ldots,a_{in}$ be disjoint sections in their relative smooth loci, with $n\ge0$. The conventions for these families, their Cartier divisors $D_i$ and their canonical relative dualizing modules $\omega_{X_i/R}$ are those of [lem-sfb-nodal-log-canonical-reconstruction], without its positivity assumption. Write $L_i=\omega_{X_i/R}(D_i)$ [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. For every $K$-isomorphism $u:(X_1)_K\xrightarrow{\sim}(X_2)_K$ sending the marked sections according to a permutation, the canonical pullback on logarithmic pluricanonical forms satisfies, for every integer $m\ge0$, $$u^*\!\left(\operatorname{im}\big(H^0(X_2,L_2^{\otimes m})\to H^0((X_2)_K,(L_2)_K^{\otimes m})\big)\right)=\operatorname{im}\big(H^0(X_1,L_1^{\otimes m})\to H^0((X_1)_K,(L_1)_K^{\otimes m})\big).$$ The restriction maps displayed here are injective. The equalities respect multiplication and the unit, so identify the graded $R$-subalgebras given by these images in the identified generic section algebras [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Stability is not assumed; the generic fibre may already be nodal.

source.place: Agent logarithmic section-lattice formulation of the common-model comparison underlying Tag 0E97 (lemma-unique-stable-model), proof. Tag 0E97 itself assumes a smooth unmarked generic curve and does not state this generalization. The marked and persistently nodal comparison is a new prerequisite, motivated by de Jong 1997 section 3.8; a local pointed-curve reference is WANTED (Knudsen, The projectivity of the moduli space of stable curves II, sections 1--2).

proof.text: Relabel the second marking by the prescribed permutation. By [lem-sfb-common-nodal-model] choose $Y$, $p_i:Y\to X_i$ and finite closed special-fibre sets $Z_i$ with $p_i^{-1}U_i\cong U_i$, $U_i=X_i\setminus Z_i$, and $(p_2)_K=u\circ(p_1)_K$. The families $X_i$ and $Y$ satisfy the marked nodal hypotheses. By [lem-sfb-nodal-log-canonical-reconstruction] their canonical logarithmic modules $L_i,L_Y$ are invertible, without positivity.

source.place: Common-model and Hartogs argument inspired by Tag 0E97 (lemma-unique-stable-model), not its verbatim proof. The marked and persistently nodal common-domination and logarithmic-pullback inputs are separately named prerequisites; 0E97 alone is insufficient.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-flat-curve-line-depth] to each $X_i$ and $L_i$, and also to $Y,L_Y$. Their special fibres are reduced pure curves and all three families are flat of finite type. It gives injectivity of every generic restriction and depth at least two at each $z\in Z_i$, as well as Noetherian total spaces.

source.place: Common-model and Hartogs argument inspired by Tag 0E97 (lemma-unique-stable-model), not its verbatim proof. The marked and persistently nodal common-domination and logarithmic-pullback inputs are separately named prerequisites; 0E97 alone is insufficient.

proof.text: Each $p_i$ is proper and respects the relabelled sections by step 1. Use [lem-sfb-nodal-log-dualizing-pullback] to obtain $\alpha_i:p_i^*L_i\to L_Y$, canonically an isomorphism on $p_i^{-1}U_i$. Apply [lem-sfb-modification-line-section-comparison] with $M=L_i$, $N=L_Y$, $Z=Z_i$. Its boundary depth hypothesis is step 2; its other hypotheses are step 1. Its generic map is precisely $(p_i)_K^*$ by the normalization of $\alpha_i$. Writing $A_{i,m}$ and $A_{Y,m}$ for the respective generic restriction images, we obtain $(p_i)_K^*A_{i,m}=A_{Y,m}$ in every degree, including zero, and these comparisons preserve tensor multiplication and the unit.

source.place: Common-model and Hartogs argument inspired by Tag 0E97 (lemma-unique-stable-model), not its verbatim proof. The marked and persistently nodal common-domination and logarithmic-pullback inputs are separately named prerequisites; 0E97 alone is insufficient.

proof.text: Thus $(p_1)_K^*A_{1,m}=A_{Y,m}=(p_2)_K^*A_{2,m}$. Since $(p_2)_K=u\circ(p_1)_K$, functoriality of pullback gives $(p_2)_K^*=(p_1)_K^*u^*$. Cancel the bijection $(p_1)_K^*$ to obtain $A_{1,m}=u^*A_{2,m}$. The algebra compatibilities supplied in step 3 pass through this cancellation; the operations are precisely those of [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Equivalently $u^*(s\otimes t)=u^*s\otimes u^*t$ and $u^*(1)=1$. Step 2 gives both claimed injections. No degree is rescaled.
